theater: 突尼斯平原與阿爾及利亞高原

battle.name: 塔卡法利納斯人的起義
battle.theater: 突尼斯平原與阿爾及利亞高原
battle.brief: 公元十七年，努米底亞王子塔卡法利納斯在阿爾及利亞高原舉兵，掠入羅馬的阿非利加行省，羅馬總督與第三奧古斯都軍團奉命追剿。叛軍靠山區游擊、羅馬靠堡壘上的連續射擊弩機守關，十八年首領陣亡，叛亂平定。卡面的秦連弩屬東亞守城弩機，與本戰役相隔逾兩千年，並未出現在北非。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 塔卡法利納斯人的起義是公元十七年起、十八年平息的北非邊疆戰爭，戰場在羅馬的阿非利加行省（今日突尼斯）與努米底亞舊土（今日阿爾及利亞東部）交界的草原與山區。叛方是塔卡法利納斯本人與努米底亞馬西利人（Massylii）王族，他以馬西尼薩的親族身分號召山區部族，得到穆蘇拉米人（Musulamii）、馬齊克斯人（Mazices）與蓋圖利人（Gaetuli）遊牧群支持；實際指揮靠部落首長的個人威望維持，沒有羅馬式的統一編制與後勤體系，騎兵是骨幹。羅馬一方以行省總督為最高指揮，駐防第三奧古斯都軍團（Legio III Augusta）與各類輔助軍，阿蘭騎兵大隊、步兵大隊以及摩爾人、蓋圖利步兵隊分駐要點，另有北非附庸國毛里塔尼亞的國王朱巴二世站在羅馬這邊；羅馬元老院掌握撥款與大軍調度，行省總督每次用兵都須上報。羅馬控制迦太基、烏提卡等行省城與地中海港口，行省每年向意大利輸出小麥與穀物，叛軍切斷高地與平原的通路，等於直接攻擊帝國的糧源與稅源。
countriesEn: The Revolt of Tacfarinas was a frontier war in North Africa that broke out in AD 17 and was suppressed in AD 18. It was fought in the belt of steppe and mountain country where the Roman province of Africa Proconsularis (modern Tunisia) met the old soil of Numidia (modern eastern Algeria). The insurgents were Tacfarinas himself and the royal house of the Massylii of Numidia: claiming kinship with the Massinissa line, he rallied the mountain tribes and drew in the Musulamii, the Mazices and the nomadic Gaetuli. Command was personal rather than institutional, held together by the standing of individual clan chiefs, with no Roman-style order of battle and no supply system to speak of; cavalry was the backbone. On the Roman side the proconsul of Africa held overall command, with Legio III Augusta and a mixed screen of auxiliaries — alae of cavalry, cohortes of foot, and Moorish and Gaetulian infantry recruited locally — garrisoned at the key points, while the client king of Mauretania, Juba II, stood on the Roman side. The Senate in Rome controlled the money and the dispatch of major units, and every provincial commitment had to be reported upward. Rome held the provincial cities of Carthage and Utica and the Mediterranean ports, and the province shipped grain and tax revenue to Italy every year; by cutting the roads between the highlands and the plain, the rebels struck directly at the empire's grain supply and fiscal base.
people: 核心人物是塔卡法利納斯。他是馬西利王族的支系，號稱是前148年去世的努米底亞國王馬西尼薩（Massinissa）的後裔；羅馬取消努米底亞王位、把這片土地併入行省之後，他因封地與牲畜被行省官員徵收而失去根基，遂於公元十七年糾集舊部與山區部族起兵。他不作正面會戰，只在有利地勢集中兵力，席捲行省北部的城鎮與莊園，同時吸收羅馬軍中逃亡的士兵與被釋放的俘虜，於是隊伍裡出現了羅馬式的裝備與拉丁語的喊聲。羅馬方面的指揮官在古典文獻中互有出入，一般敘述提到行省總督層級的將領、陣亡在野戰中的指揮官 Censorinus，以及最終在十八年平定叛亂的 Marcus Gavius Maximus；皇帝提比略在羅馬坐鎮，元老院收到急報後批准調兵與撥款。另一個關鍵人物是毛里塔尼亞國王朱巴二世，他與凱撒家族通婚，是羅馬在北非最穩固的附庸，本質上以自己的兵力替羅馬守住高原的西緣。所有關於此戰的敘述都出自塔西佗的《編年史》與卡西烏斯·狄奧的《羅馬史》殘篇，因此人物的細節多有互相矛盾之處，只能取其大略。
peopleEn: The central figure is Tacfarinas himself. He belonged to a cadet branch of the Massylii royal house and claimed descent from Massinissa, the Numidian king who died in 148 BC. After Rome abolished the Numidian kingship and folded the country into the proconsular province, his estates and herds were taken over by provincial officials, and he lost his base of support; in AD 17 he rallied his old retainers and the mountain clans and rose in revolt. He avoided set-piece battle, concentrating his strength only on favourable ground, sweeping through the towns and estates of the northern province, and he took in deserters from the Roman ranks and released prisoners, so that his force began to carry Roman equipment and to shout in Latin. The Roman commanders are reported inconsistently in the classical sources: the usual narrative names a general of proconsular rank, the commander Censorinus who fell in the field, and Marcus Gavius Maximus, who finally put the revolt down in AD 18. The emperor Tiberius remained in Rome, and the Senate, on receiving the dispatches, authorised the dispatch of troops and the money. Another decisive personality was Juba II, king of Mauretania, who was married into the Julio-Clavian family and was Rome's most reliable client in North Africa; in effect his own troops held the western edge of the highlands for Rome. Everything known about this war comes from fragments of Tacitus' Annals and of Cassius Dio's Roman History, so the details of persons conflict constantly and only the broad outlines can be used.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦連弩，即戰國末至兩漢的連射弩機：弩機以蹼板與曲柄蓄力，矢匣一次容納數十支至百餘支短矢，踩下踏桿即完成一次上弦與發射，射程約百步上下，主要用途是守城、守壘以及壓制密集的攻城隊形。它與公元十七年的北非戰場相隔逾兩千年，本身不可能出現在阿特拉斯山麓，這一點必須先說清楚；它在此代表的是「弩機」這一類把射速、持續火力與低操作技術結合起來的守城射擊武器譜系。當時北非真正服役的同類裝備是羅馬的扭力弩砲：cheiroballista 與 Scorpio 這類可重複操作的機械弩，以及固定在牆上的重型投石砲，羅馬守軍用它們在堡壘與關隘上覆蓋進攻者的密集隊形。步戰裝備方面，羅馬步兵以重標槍 pilum 配小圓盾與長方盾、gladius Hispaniensis 短劍，配頭盔與分段甲或鎖子甲，輔助軍則用更輕的標槍、弓與長矛。叛軍沒有制式甲胄，靠努米底亞與蓋圖利騎兵的速度、長矛、投槍與短刀，另有從莊園與城鎮奪來的銅鐵器物。攻城與運輸方面，羅馬用撞柱、雲梯與木製堡壘群封鎖邊境，糧秣以海運自迦太基、烏提卡等港口，再用驢騾與貨車轉運內陸；叛軍就地取糧、以劫掠維持，騎兵行動本身不依賴大型補給線。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow, the magazine-fed crossbow of the late Warring States and Han periods: the lock stores its draw in the stirrup and the crank, the magazine holds several dozen to more than a hundred short bolts, and stepping on the treadle completes cocking and loosing in one motion, with a range of roughly a hundred paces; its purpose was to hold a wall, a fort or a camp against a dense assault. It stands more than two thousand years away from the North African battlefield of AD 17 and could not have appeared in the foothills of the Atlas; it stands here for the family of bolt-throwers that combined rate of fire, sustained output and low crew skill in the defence of fortified positions. The equipment actually serving that role in North Africa was the Roman torsion artillery: engines such as the cheiroballista and the Scorpio that could be reloaded repeatedly, and the heavier stone-throwers fixed in the walls, with which the Roman defenders swept the massed formations of the attackers from their blockhouses and passes. On foot, the Roman legionary fought with the heavy pilum, the small round shield and the oblong scutum, with the gladius Hispaniensis, a helmet, and either segmented or mail armour, while the auxiliaries carried lighter javelins, bows and spears. The rebels had no uniform armour; they relied on the speed of their Numidian and Gaetulian cavalry, with spears, throwing javelins and short swords, plus whatever bronze and iron they could seize from estates and towns. For siege and transport, Rome used rams, ladders and a chain of timber blockhouses to seal the frontier; grain moved by sea from ports such as Carthage and Utica and was then carried inland on mules and wagons. The rebels lived off the country they raided, and cavalry operations of their own did not depend on a heavy supply train.
tactics: 叛軍的戰術核心是不對決：塔卡法利納斯把部族聯盟的騎兵分成小隊，進入阿特拉斯山與奧雷斯山的谷地、沼澤與牧場之間，遇敵則散，敵過則襲，專打羅馬的糧道、莊園與落單的輔助軍，羅馬主力逼近就退入山地；同時破壞行省的農莊與灌溉設施，使羅馬在平原的稅收與糧源受損，拖到雨季與酷暑迫使羅馬大軍退營。羅馬方面採正面推進加上據點封鎖的組合：第三奧古斯都軍團與輔助步兵列陣前推，盾牌互接形成烏龜陣抵禦箭雨與投槍，弩砲與弓箭手在行軍縱隊與堡壘上覆蓋敵軍前鋒，騎兵大隊負責切斷退路與追擊潰兵；關鍵是沿山區邊緣修築連續的堡壘與觀察哨，把叛軍出入山口的幾條路封死，使游擊無法轉化為會戰，再用正面大軍在缺口處吃掉叛軍主力。補給上，羅馬靠港口與行省城鎮的海運加陸運維持遠端基地，叛軍則以劫掠莊園的穀物、牲畜與榨油產品維持，兩者的后勤負擔完全相反；北非夏季酷熱乾旱，羅馬大軍避免正午行軍，山地小徑每日只能推進八到十公里，追擊因此極慢。
tacticsEn: The heart of the rebel method was the refusal to be pinned down. Tacfarinas broke the tribal federation's cavalry into small bands and moved them among the valleys, marshes and pastures of the Atlas and the Aures: scattering when a Roman column appeared, falling on it when it passed, striking the grain convoys, the estates and isolated auxiliaries, and withdrawing into the hills whenever the main Roman force closed in. At the same time he wrecked the farms and irrigation works of the province so that the revenue and the grain of the plain suffered, hoping to hold the Roman army in its camps through the rains and the heat. Rome combined a frontal advance with a cordon of fixed posts: Legio III Augusta and the auxiliary infantry marched in line, shields interlocking into testudes against the rain of arrows and javelins, while bolt-throwers and archers on the march and from the blockhouses swept the enemy vanguard, and the cavalry alae cut off the retreat and pursued the broken. The decisive element was a continuous line of blockhouses and watch posts along the edge of the highlands, sealing the few tracks by which the rebels could reach the passes, so that their skirmishing could never be converted into a set-piece battle; the main army then took the rebel mass at the gaps. In logistics the two sides were opposites: Rome sustained its far-flung bases by sea and land from the ports and provincial towns, while the rebels lived on grain, livestock and oil squeezed from the estates they raided. The North African summer is hot and dry, the Roman army avoided marching at midday, and on mountain paths the advance was at most eight to ten kilometres a day, so pursuit was painfully slow.
data: 可確認的數字非常有限。時間上，起義在公元十七年展開，十八年被平定，前後約一年半到兩年；羅馬的決策與戰報都經元老院，日期只能定到年。地理上，戰區北起阿特拉斯山與奧雷斯山，南抵迦太基一線，山區到迦太基的直線距離約四百公里，巴格拉達斯河（今突尼斯的梅澤爾達河）縱貫行省北部，卡薩因山口是山區通往平原的主要咽喉，羅馬的堡壘線正是沿這條線上的幾處關口鋪開。兵力方面，可以寫實的是編制與常見規模：第三奧古斯都軍團是主力，羅馬各類輔助單位的常見規模為步兵大隊四百到八百人、騎兵大隊五百到一千人，另有行省徵召的摩爾人與蓋圖利步兵；這些是羅馬制度下的典型數字，並非本戰役的確切點名。裝備與供應亦有常見參照值：羅馬弩砲的有效射程一般被估計在一百五十到三百公尺，野戰軍每人每日需穀物約一公斤半、葡萄酒約一公升量級，羅馬軍隊平地日行約二十公里，翻山每日八到十公里。古典文獻沒有留下雙方確切的死傷與俘虜數目，關於損失的各種精確數字都屬後世推算，本卡不採用。
dataEn: Few figures can be stated with confidence. On timing: the revolt opened in AD 17 and was suppressed in AD 18, a matter of roughly a year and a half to two years; since the decisions and the dispatches all passed through the Senate, the chronology can only be fixed to the year. On geography: the theatre ran from the Atlas and the Aures in the north down to the line of Carthage, about four hundred kilometres in a straight line from the highlands to the city; the Bagradas, now the Medjerda in Tunisia, ran through the northern province; the Kasserine pass was the main throat between mountain and plain, and it was along the passes on that line that Rome laid out its chain of blockhouses. On strength: what can be written honestly is the order of battle and the usual scale of units. Legio III Augusta was the backbone, the normal strength of Roman auxiliary cohorts of foot was four to eight hundred men and of cavalry alae five hundred to a thousand, and there were Moorish and Gaetulian infantry raised in the province. These are the standard figures of the Roman system, not an enumeration of the units actually present. For equipment and supply there are likewise familiar reference values: the effective range of Roman bolt-throwers is generally estimated at one hundred fifty to three hundred metres, a field army needed on the order of one and a half kilograms of grain and a litre of wine per man per day, and a Roman column covered about twenty kilometres a day on level ground but only eight to ten over mountain tracks. The ancient sources preserve no reliable casualty or prisoner figures for either side; the precise numbers of losses found in modern reconstructions are estimates, and this card does not use them.
cause: 起義的直接原因是羅馬在北非的徵收與土地政策。前一世紀羅馬把努米底亞王國拆分成若干附庸王國，最終在公元前一世紀末把整片土地併入阿非利加行省，王族名號被取消，土地與牧場被劃為行省地，牧場租給羅馬貴族與意大利商人，稅賦按羅馬的標準征收。馬西利王族的封地被收奪，部族首長失去原有的司法與徵召權，山區的穆蘇拉米、馬齊克斯與蓋圖利各部也被迫交出牲畜、接受駐軍與徵召。第二層原因是帝國當年的兵力吃緊：公元十六年羅馬把駐埃及的第九西班牙軍團調往多瑙河方向，北方戰線與東方形勢同時吃重，北非行省只能依靠既有的軍團與輔助軍自行應付，總督派出的第一批追擊部隊因此兵力薄弱，給了叛軍可乘之機。第三層原因是地理與傳統：阿特拉斯山與奧雷斯山之間的草原地帶長期由部族自治，羅馬的邊界線一直推到山麓才停，兩套秩序在十七年裡的徵稅、徵兵與牧場糾紛中正面碰撞；塔卡法利納斯所做的，是把四散的怨恨整合成一次有明確王族號召、有共同戰術方法的起義。
causeEn: The immediate cause was Roman fiscal and land policy in North Africa. During the first century BC Rome broke the Numidian kingdom into a set of client monarchies and finally, by the end of that century, absorbed the whole country into the province of Africa Proconsularis: the royal title was abolished, the land and the pastures were entered as provincial territory, the pastures were let to Roman aristocrats and Italian businessmen, and taxation was levied by Roman standards. The Massylii royal estates were taken away, the clan chiefs lost their ancient jurisdiction and their right to call up a levy, and the Musulamii, Mazices and Gaetuli in the mountains were pressed to hand over livestock and to accept garrisons and recruitment. A second cause was the strain on the empire's military resources in those years: in AD 16 Rome moved Legio IX Hispana out of Egypt towards the Danube, the northern front and the situation in the east were both absorbing, and the province of Africa had to meet the emergency with the legions and auxiliaries it already had. The first columns the proconsul sent out were therefore thin, and the rebels took the chance. A third cause was geography and custom: the steppe between the Atlas and the Aures had long been administered by the clans themselves, and the Roman frontier only reached the foot of the mountains, so two systems of order collided head on over taxes, levies and pasture in the seventeen – and Tacfarinas did what a leader can do with such a collision, gathering scattered grievances into a rising that had both a royal claim and a common method of war.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接結果是羅馬恢復了對阿非利加行省的控制，並且把邊界線從山麓往山區推了一步。戰後羅馬在努米底亞舊地留下一條由堡壘、觀察哨與軍團駐地組成的控制線，第三奧古斯都軍團的駐地阿馬達拉（Ammaedara）成為這條線的支點之一，羅馬在阿爾及利亞的軍事足跡由此固定下來。制度上，羅馬把北非的守備主力定為軍團加輔助軍的混合編制，蓋圖利與摩爾人步兵被大量徵用為邊境兵源，阿蘭騎兵大隊成為追擊游擊部隊的常備力量；毛里塔尼亞的朱巴二世則因站在羅馬一方而鞏固了附庸地位，羅馬在十八年之後把對北非的干預重心由行省轉向這位附庸王。對北非社會而言，王族獨立的傳統被打斷，阿爾及利亞高原的部族聯盟此後難以重建，羅馬的直接統治第一次穩定地延伸到山區的邊緣；幾十年後朱巴二世得以在圖加爾特建立新都、把原屬努米底亞的部分地區併入毛里塔尼亞，正是建立在這場戰爭之後羅馬對高原控制鬆動的基礎上。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the war was the restoration of Roman control over the province of Africa and a step forward of the frontier from the foot of the mountains into the highlands. Rome left behind a line of blockhouses, watch posts and legionary stations across the old soil of Numidia; Ammaedara, the base of Legio III Augusta, became one of the props of that line, and Rome's military footprint in Algeria was thereby fixed. Institutionally, the defence of North Africa was settled as a mixed system of legion and auxiliaries: Gaetulian and Moorish infantry were levied in large numbers as frontier troops, and the cavalry alae became the standing force for pursuing raiding bands. Juba II of Mauretania, having stood on the Roman side, saw his client position strengthened, and after AD 18 Rome increasingly directed its North African policy through that client king rather than through the province alone. For North African society the blow fell on the tradition of independent kingship: the tribal confederation of the Algerian plateau could not be reconstituted, and direct Roman rule reached the edge of the highlands for the first time in a stable way. Decades later Juba II would establish his new capital at Touggourt and annex the former Numidian lands to Mauretania, on the strength of the loosening of Roman control over the plateau that followed this war.
result: 公元十八年，羅馬集中兵力在野戰中擊敗叛軍主力，塔卡法利納斯本人陣亡，關於他的生平細節沒有留下可以追述的記載。首領死後，部族聯盟迅速瓦解，起義的規模很快從全面攻勢退回到零星抵抗；羅馬沒有進行大規模的鎮壓，而是以外交手段拆分部族、把大批追隨者重新編入行省與軍隊，並以連續的堡壘線與常駐的第三奧古斯都軍團守住山口與牧場通道，讓游擊無法再轉成會戰。戰爭之後，阿非利加行省的稅賦與穀物供應恢復正常，迦太基與羅馬之間的往來回到戰前的水位。從羅馬的角度看，這是一場代價不大、曆時約兩年、由行省軍隊自行解決的邊疆戰事；從起義者的角度，結果則是徹底的失敗，努米底亞王室的反抗旗號就此中斷，馬西利人重新回到部族首長與羅馬行省的雙重秩序裡，幾百年後北非再出現大規模反羅馬動員時，已經沒有可援引的王族血脈可以號召。
resultEn: In AD 18 Rome concentrated its forces, beat the rebel main body in the field, and Tacfarinas was killed there; nothing survives that can be traced of his life. With the leader dead the tribal confederation came apart quickly, and the rising shrank from a general offensive to scattered resistance. Rome did not answer with a general massacre: it broke up the clans by negotiation, took many of the followers back into the province and the army, and held the passes and the pastoral tracks with a continuous line of blockhouses and the permanent presence of Legio III Augusta, so that skirmishing could no longer be turned into a battle. After the war the taxes and the grain shipments of the province of Africa resumed their normal course, and the traffic between Carthage and Rome returned to its former volume. Seen from Rome this was a costly, two-year frontier war fought and paid for by the provincial army; seen from the insurgents it was an outright defeat. The banner of Numidian royal revolt was broken, the Massylii were folded back into the double order of clan chief and Roman provincial subject, and when North Africa produced great anti-Roman mobilisations again centuries later there was no royal blood left to call on.
